name: leveraged_fx_stop_versus_margin_closeout
question_template: A trader opens a long position of {UNITS} base-currency units at a spot quote of USD {SPOT} per unit with {LEV}:1 leverage, funded by an account holding USD {EQUITY}. Required margin is fixed at the entry notional divided by the leverage. Account equity equals the deposit plus the unrealised P/L of the position; one pip is a quote change of USD 0.0001 per unit. The broker closes the whole position automatically when equity falls to {CLOSEOUT} percent of required margin, with no slippage. The trader also places a stop-loss {STOP_PIPS} pips below the entry quote. The quote then declines steadily. Determine which exit fires first (if both would fire at the same quote, the stop-loss fires) and compute the signed realised P/L in USD at that exit; a loss is negative. Use exact arithmetic.

slots.description: USD quote per unit triggering automatic close-out.
Adverse pips from entry to close-out.

program:
def solve():
    N = P["UNITS"]
    S0 = P["SPOT"]
    L = P["LEV"]
    E = P["EQUITY"]
    c = P["CLOSEOUT"]
    k = P["STOP_PIPS"]
    pip = Q("0.0001")
    req = N * S0 / L
    if E <= req:
        raise ValueError("deposit does not cover required margin")
    equity_at_close = req * c / 100
    loss_to_close = E - equity_at_close
    if loss_to_close <= 0:
        raise ValueError("close-out would trigger immediately")
    s_close = S0 - loss_to_close / N
    if s_close <= 0:
        raise ValueError("close-out quote not positive")
    pip_value = N * pip
    pips_close = loss_to_close / pip_value
    if k <= pips_close:
        trigger = "stop_loss"
        pl = -k * pip_value
    else:
        trigger = "margin_closeout"
        pl = -loss_to_close
    return {
        "final": pl,
        "required_margin_trace": req,
        "closeout_quote_trace": s_close,
        "closeout_pips_trace": pips_close,
        "exit_trigger_trace": trigger,
    }
